Harper Lee: Hey @people-ops — quick Q: how do I switch my maintenance prescription (metformin) to home delivery? Want to set up a 90-day mail-order refill. My member ID ends with 4821 and the plan is Redwood Health PPO. Do I need a prior auth or any special form?

Katie M.: Hey Harper! You can transfer to mail-order a few ways: 1) Ask your current retail pharmacy to submit a transfer request to the mail-order vendor; 2) Or request it in the insurer's member portal under Medications > Mail Order. Quick checklist: BIN/PCN/Group/Rx group + full member ID and prescriber info. Example values from an ID card: BIN `004336`, PCN `RX123`, Group `RDFD` — bring those to the pharmacy.

Katie M.: Timeline: usually 7–14 business days for the first mail-order fill. If your drug requires prior auth (controlled substances, specialty meds, or non-generic brands), your provider must submit the PA to the carrier — that can add time. If you want, I can start the transfer with your preferred mail-order vendor once you DM me the full member ID and preferred vendor.

Lina (Benefits): adding a couple of plan specifics — for Redwood Health PPO mail-order counts toward the same deductible as retail for maintenance meds. Copay structure: a 90-day mail-order fill typically uses an adjusted copay (roughly 2–3x the 30-day retail single copay, depends on plan tier). Metformin (generic) rarely needs PA but if your prescription is for a brand or has a dose change your prescriber may need to submit supporting docs. If you need to fax a PA, our carrier's PA fax (example) is 1-800-555-1212.

benefits-bot: Carrier mail-order portal: https://carrier.example.com/mailorder — login with your member ID (full ID required).

Harper Lee: Awesome — Walgreens told me they can transfer but asked for the insurer BIN/PCN. I'll DM my full member ID and prefer CVS Mail Order. Can you initiate it?

Katie M.: Yep — DM me the full member ID and I'll place the transfer/request with CVS mail-order and confirm once it's submitted. I will also note expected ship window so you can plan refills. :thumbsup:

Harper Lee: Sent the DM. Thanks both!
